sourceQuote: 1.Non-chinese nationality citizens 2.Aged between 18-50 3.Be in good health 4.High school degree or equivalent 5.HSK level 6 or above, those who don't have the HSK certificate should take the Chinese Language Examination hold by Nankai University.
targetQuote: 1.非中国国籍公民 2。年龄在 18-50 岁至 3 岁之间 4。身体健康 5。具有高中学历或同等学历 HSK。达到 6 级或以上学历者，如无 HSK 证书，应参加由南开大学举办的中文考试。
